meta.title: Publicly owned property and land across the Lancashire-14
meta.transfers_note: Only county and district (borough/city) council property passes to the new unitary councils. Town and parish councils continue, and the NHS, police, fire, ambulance and national agencies keep their own estates.

sources.councils: HM Land Registry Commercial & Corporate Ownership Data (CCOD), July 2026
sources.education: DfE Get Information About Schools (GIAS), open state-funded establishments
sources.fire: Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service station list

meta.coverage_note: Council, NHS, police and government titles come from HM Land Registry (CCOD). Addressed sites are placed precisely by postcode; council land parcels without a postcode are placed approximately by locality and shown faded. Schools, fire and ambulance stations are placed precisely.
